blocks.text: Dear Ms. Gonzalez:

Thank you for the time you and the owners have given us over these past weeks, and for the candor of those conversations about what a sale would mean for the company and for the people who built it. This letter sets out the terms on which Quillon Harbor Advisors will act as exclusive financial advisor to {{fact:f:E-2014-001.client}} in connection with a possible sale of the business, and it becomes our agreement when you countersign it and return a copy to me.
What We Will Deliver

Our work will take the form of a negotiated sale process, conducted in confidence and directed to a defined group of strategic and financial parties, not to the market at large. Over the course of the engagement we will deliver the following:

items: A review of the company's historical financial statements and of management's projections, together with a valuation analysis drawn from comparable transactions and public-company trading levels, which we will take you through before any party is approached.
A buyer universe scoped at {{fact:f:E-2014-001.scope}}, strategic and financial, which we will refine with you and which you will approve party by party before we make a single call.

A short teaser that describes the business by sector and size without naming it, and a confidential information memorandum released only to parties who have signed a non-disclosure agreement in a form you have approved.
Management of the outreach, the non-disclosure agreements, and every question that comes back from interested parties, so that your team deals with one point of contact throughout.
An organized virtual data room, and preparation of your management team for presentations to the parties invited into a second round.

The solicitation and side-by-side comparison of indications of interest and final offers, with our written recommendation on each, and support to you and your counsel through the letter of intent, the definitive agreement, and closing.

blocks.text: The order of that work matters as much as its content. We will not contact anyone until you have approved both the memorandum and the list, and once outreach begins we will report to you each week on who has been approached, who has signed, and who has declined, so that nothing about the process reaches you second-hand.

We will need a good deal from you in return. The work depends on timely access to the company's financial records and its senior managers, and on your willingness to tell us early about anything a buyer might later find on its own. We will keep our requests organized and as light as the process allows, though there will be weeks, around the memorandum and the management presentations in particular, when the demands on your team are real.
How We Have Staffed It

Mark Allen, a Partner of the firm, will lead the engagement and will be your first call on any question about the process, its calendar, or where the buyers stand. Rachel Brown, a Vice President, will direct the preparation of the memorandum and the data room and will manage diligence as requests arrive, and she has a habit of telling owners what a buyer will ask for well before the buyer gets around to asking.

They will be supported by an analyst from our Advisory group, and I will stay close to the work throughout, reading each document before it leaves our office for a buyer. We keep our deal teams small and constant, so the people you meet at the first working session are the people who will sit with you at closing.
Fees and Payment

For the services described in this letter, {{fact:f:E-2014-001.client}} will pay us a fee of {{fact:f:E-2014-001.fee}}. We will send our invoices to you directly, and they are payable on receipt. The company will also reimburse our reasonable out-of-pocket expenses, chiefly travel, printing, and the cost of hosting the data room, and we will ask for your approval before incurring any expense outside those categories.
Term and Termination

Our engagement begins on {{fact:f:E-2014-001.start}} and continues until a transaction closes or until either of us ends it by written notice to the other. A process of this kind generally runs for the better part of a year, though its pace will depend on the buyers as much as on us. If the engagement ends before a transaction closes, the fee provisions of this letter will continue to apply to any transaction with a party introduced during the engagement that closes within twelve months of termination.
Confidentiality

We will hold in confidence all non-public information the company provides to us and will use it only for the purposes of this engagement. No prospective buyer will learn the company's name until it has signed a non-disclosure agreement, and in anything that circulates before that point the business will be described by its sector and its size alone. These obligations survive the end of the engagement, however it ends.
Our Independence

We act for the company alone in this matter. We will accept no fee or other compensation from any prospective buyer in connection with this transaction, and if we become aware of a relationship that might reasonably be seen to compromise our advice, we will tell you before we go any further.
Limitation of Liability

We will bring care and our best professional judgment to this work, but we cannot promise that a buyer will be found or that a transaction will close on any particular terms. Our aggregate liability arising out of this engagement is limited to the fees the company has actually paid us, neither party will be liable to the other for indirect or consequential loss, and the company will indemnify us against third-party claims arising from our role except where our own gross negligence or willful misconduct is found to have caused the loss.
Governing Law

This letter is governed by the laws of the state in which our principal office is located, and any dispute arising under it will be heard in the courts of that state. It is the entire agreement between us regarding this engagement and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties.

If these terms reflect your understanding, please sign the enclosed copy where indicated and return it to me. When it reaches us, Mark Allen will call you to fix a date for the first working session, at which we will go through the information request list with you.
